'''April 2002 Seattle tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Booster Pack Games, Lake City Way, Seattle, Washington on 20 April 2002. It is known from Tom Potter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3601">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-23-booster-pack-seattle-wash-4-20-02d3601/ booster-pack-seattle-wash-4-20-02], DeckTech (Tom "Majin" Potter, 23 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-23-booster-pack-seattle-wash-4-20-02d3601/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 20 April 2002
* '''Site:''' Booster Pack Games, Lake City Way, Seattle, Washington
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Players:''' 10
